name: Benicci Stylish Blue Light Blocking Computer Glasses for Men and Women
blurb: Benicci's classic-frame computer glasses at under $18 - a 15,000-plus rating staple the brand credits with easing screen eyestrain and supporting normal sleep patterns.

name: 5 Pack Reading Glasses for Women- Blue Light Readers (2.0)
blurb: A five-pack of women's readers that pairs 2.0 magnification with blue-light filtering and anti-reflective lenses - two dollars a pair, each with its own PU case and cleaning cloth.

name: CARFIA Acetate Polarized Sunglasses for Men UV400 Protection Classic Retro Square Shades Driving Glasses
blurb: Retro square frames cut from Italian acetate with polarized UV400 lenses - each pair ships with a hard case, leather pouch, polarized test card and cleaning cloth.

name: TIJN Sleep Glasses with Blue Green Light Blocking, Red Light Lens for Computer Gaming, Screen Fatigue & UV Protection
blurb: Tinted red lenses built for screen sessions and unwinding before bed - the listing says they filter blue and green light, and 53,000-plus ratings average 4.4 stars.

name: Blue Light Glasses for Woman/Men
blurb: Just under eight dollars for anti-reflective HD lenses in a lightweight 140mm frame with a swappable-lens design - 10,000-plus ratings average 4.5 stars.

name: 6 Pack Reading Glasses by BOOST EYEWEAR, Traditional Frames in Assorted Colors, for Men and Women, with Spring Loaded Hinges
blurb: Six pairs for $14.99 - about $2.50 each - in black, tortoise shell, blue and red with spring-loaded hinges and two cleaning cloths, so one can live in every room.

name: Eyekepper Readers, Clear Frame Reading Glasses, 5pack for Men Women 2.0
blurb: Five 2.0-magnification pairs in clear frames for $14.99 - under three dollars a pair in a look that reads less like drugstore readers than most.

name: ZENOTTIC Polarized Sunglasses for Men Lightweight TR90 Frame UV400 Protection Square Sun Glasses
blurb: Square TR90 frames that barely register on the face - the UV400 TAC lenses are rated to block 100% of UVA, UVB and UVC, and every pair ships with a polarized test card so you can check the tint yourself.

name: SOJOS Retro Polarized Aviator Sunglasses Womens Mens SJ2385
blurb: A retro aviator for under $14 - polycarbonate frames with UV400 TAC polarized lenses and metal hinges, though SOJOS notes the light-tint colourways cut less glare than the dark ones.
